Mission Concept & Rationale / Project Plan & Preliminary Progress

technical_issues.issue: States a 'geostationary orbit at an altitude of 600 km'; GEO altitude is about 35,786 km, so 600 km is LEO and cannot remain fixed over the reef.
Text says Weeks 7 and 8 are reserved for editing/finalisation, but the Gantt shows Editing & Finalisation in Weeks 9–10.
No explicit planned information-source list is provided, despite the requirement; references only support the concept section.
No preliminary orbital calculations, COE/AOE results or simulation outputs are presented; progress is mainly tutorials and background research.

overall: Mission concept is strong and well referenced, but the project plan lacks contingency and planned sources, and preliminary technical work is thin. The GEO-at-600-km statement is a major error. Presentation is good. Weighted estimate about 70/100.
